# CliFn

> Reusable CLI building blocks for command execution, output, configuration, credentials, and safe automation.

## Documentation

- [Subprocesses and scaffolding](https://clifn.com/docs/automation) — Execute commands and create files with explicit limits and overwrite policy.
- [Build a CLI](https://clifn.com/docs/cli-builder) — Wire any parser to the shared action runner and preserve command ownership.
- [Configuration](https://clifn.com/docs/configuration) — Load local config files, JSON project settings, and typed environment values.
- [Credentials and HTTP client](https://clifn.com/docs/credentials-and-client) — Persist named profiles and make authenticated requests with bounded retries.
- [Getting started](https://clifn.com/docs/getting-started) — Install CliFn and run your first parser-independent action.
- [CliFn documentation](https://clifn.com/docs) — Build reliable command-line tools with parser-agnostic primitives.
- [Prompts and JSON stdio](https://clifn.com/docs/interaction-and-stdio) — Interactive input, terminal feedback, and machine-readable pipes.
- [Output and diagnostics](https://clifn.com/docs/output-and-diagnostics) — Use text or JSON output and stable, redacted diagnostic reports.
- [Admin capability](https://clifn.com/docs/reference/admin) — The current Super Console declaration for CliFn.
- [Package README](https://clifn.com/docs/reference/core-readme) — Complete source-aligned CliFn package guide.
- [Public exports](https://clifn.com/docs/reference/exports) — Map CliFn subpaths to their public functions, types, and errors.
- [API reference](https://clifn.com/docs/reference) — Public CliFn entry points, exports, and source-aligned package documentation.
